## Book Chapters

- OSTA — Orchestrating Spatial Transcriptomics Analysis with Bioconductor, Chapter 30: Image analysis. [Link](https://lmweber.org/OSTA/pages/ind-image-analysis.html)

## Software

- **imageTCGA** — Shiny app to explore the TCGA Diagnostic Image Database. [Bioconductor](https://www.bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/html/imageTCGA.html) · [GitHub](https://github.com/billila/imageTCGA)
- **imageFeatureTCGA** — Imports extracted TCGA H&E image features into R and integrates them with multi-omics data. [GitHub](https://github.com/waldronlab/imageFeatureTCGA)
- **imageTCGAutils** — Utility functions for CONCH data and nuclei-to-tile assignment. [GitHub](https://github.com/waldronlab/imageTCGAutils)
- **TCIAAPI** — Interface to The Cancer Imaging Archive (TCIA) API for searching/downloading images. [GitHub](https://github.com/billila/TCIAAPI)
